Content: Chat attachments support text files, browser file images, and pasted clipboard images. memorysmith.js registers the chat textarea and document paste handlers, reads clipboardData.files, permissive clipboardData.items file entries, and navigator.clipboard.read image blobs when available, then calls AttachClipboardImage with base64 data. Chat.razor enforces ChatOptions max attachment bytes/characters, saves images through ChatAttachmentFiles.SaveTempAsync under the trusted MemorySmith/ChatAttachments temp folder, stores LocalPath for provider readback, and keeps Base64Data only where needed for browser previews. Queued attachments render as chips with thumbnails when base64 is available and a dedicated X button to remove them. Ollama receives image payloads on the last user message; GitHub receives blob image attachments through the SDK.
Title: Chat Image Attachment Pipeline
